name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light mode toggle** in the top-right corner.

This maximizes visibility and liveliness by reducing eye strain in low-light conditions while giving users control. The toggle avoids modal interruptions that break flow, keeping the interface fast and enjoyable. Trade-off: some users may prefer light mode, but the default dark theme aligns with modern UI standards and reduces cognitive load for the majority.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail users with glare-sensitive conditions—like outdoor sunlight or bright indoor lights—where a light theme reduces squinting. A persistent toggle also risks cluttering the interface if the user rarely switches, while a system preference (OS-level) would settle the argument by respecting user defaults without extra UI.
